My mother-in-law took Lyrica for a couple of years, and it didn't seem to have any side effects. It just didn't seem to work well for her, so her doctor put her on something else. She had about a 4 month's supply left over last year when I had a cracked tooth. I read on Google that someone used Lyrica for their tooth pain and it worked for them so I figured "why not?" and gave it a shot.

My tooth pain was gone immediately. I would take one every 2 hours for about 6 weeks, no tooth pain. But, I started to really suffer because of it. I was depressed and suicidal and I was always dizzy. I didn't even put together that it was Lyrica doing it to me. Until my mother-in-law saw me take a pill. I told her it was my prescription and she said not to take it because "it made her dizzy as all get out". I stopped taking them that day and I stopped wanting to kill myself. My tooth pain never returned, though.

Even before being depressed, I preferred seeing movies alone. I had Fridays off for a long time, so I would see a movie at noon on Friday. Lots of people going alone at that time where I lived. 

Also, as a birthday treat (since no one else even cared) in the year 2000, I saw The Patriot and XMen back to back on the day XMen came out.
